Snowflake's Sridhar Ramaswamy on Creating Reliable AI for Businesses

name: PayPal | Sequoia Capital
p: For more than 20 years, PayPal has remained at the forefront of the digital payment revolution, growing into a two-sided network that connects merchants and consumers in more than 200 markets worldwide.
PayPal: A Merger of Enemies That Reshaped Silicon Valley
description: PayPal is a Sequoia-backed company since 1999.

name: Block | Sequoia Capital
p: Block is Square, Cash App, Spiral, TIDAL, TBD, and other foundational teams. It is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment.

Bootstrapped by Jack, Square (now Block) had a vision to allow anyone with an iPhone to become a merchant. Part hardware, part app, the mobile payments product was originally called Squirrel because of its resemblance to an acorn. A demo in which we saw Square in action (and in which we were charged $3.00) gave us a glimpse into the platform's transformative power.
Block: A Controversial Hack Week Project Becomes the #1 Financial Services App
description: Block is a Sequoia-backed company since 2011.

name: Linear | Sequoia Capital
p: Linear helps developers streamline software projects, sprints, tasks and bug tracking without hampering progress.

Linear's ambition was to become the new standard for modern software development and project management—a Jira 2.0. Karri and his team's understanding of the pain points experienced by engineers and PMs was apparent as was their ability to translate that into a product. The speed with which they moved and the early engagement they were able to drive gave us conviction that Linear could define the next generation of software development tools.
description: We help the daring build legendary companies from idea to IPO and beyond.

name: Instacart | Sequoia Capital
p: Instacart is building the best way for people around the world to shop for groceries and get them delivered instantly. With its vast network of pre-existing grocers and drivers, Instacart offers tremendous inventory and convenience to customers. Its on-demand service is available in most major U.S. metropolitan areas.
description: We help the daring build legendary companies from idea to IPO and beyond.

name: YouTube | Sequoia Capital
p: YouTube is the world’s leading video-sharing service. It makes uploading and sharing videos with family, friends and the entire world effortless. It was acquired by Google and is the web’s second most visited website.

It was 2005. User-generated content and online advertising were taking off. Video was the natural next space in this content evolution. Chad, Steve and Jawed were scrappy, smart and had built an easy-to-use product we believed in. YouTube's goal was clear from the outset—become the primary destination for user-generated video content on the web.
The Startup Story of YouTube, ft. Steve Chen
description: We help the daring build legendary companies from idea to IPO and beyond.

name: DoorDash | Sequoia Capital
h2: Tony Xu on Mastering the Last Mile
p: DoorDash is a technology and logistics company that started with on-demand door-to-door delivery. It empowers local businesses to connect with people through their platform of diners and dashers.

We sat next to Tony at a dinner one night and were amazed by how deeply he understood the logistical challenges of restaurant service. His methodical mindset, and grasp of complex, multi-sided marketplaces combined with a missionary zeal to serve local merchants convinced us that DoorDash was going to upend the last-mile logistics industry. Starting with the most complicated local businesses, restaurants in suburban America, highlighted the company's determination and ability to carve out a marketing wedge in a highly competitive market.
DoorDash ft. Tony Xu - The Long Road to Winning a Category
The 20 Minute VC: The DoorDash Memo with Alfred Lin

name: reddit | Sequoia Capital
p: Reddit is the internet’s leading source of interest-based content. Subreddits devoted to every imaginable topic form a network of highly-specific, community curated information.
The Reddit Story with Steve Huffman
description: reddit is the front page of the Internet featuring user-generated links to content around the web.

name: Apple | Sequoia Capital
p: Apple revolutionized personal technology with the Macintosh in 1984. It has repeatedly transformed the way humans interact with computers with the iPhone, iPod, MacBook, iMac and other products. Today it is the largest publicly traded company and one of the world’s most recognizable brands. Its forays into the worlds of cloud storage, wearables, music streaming and electric vehicles have proven the company continues to innovate.

Forty years ago, the concept of a "personal computer" didn't exist. We backed Steve on the idea of Apple producing a consumer-centric product at an affordable price. Since then, Apple's products have brought computing into the home, and out into the world, contributing to the disruption of nearly every industry.
Don Valentine on Investing in the young Steve Jobs

p: Klarna eases the pain of the checkout process by separating purchase from payment. With Klarna, users proceed to checkout while Klarna foots the bill and invoices later.

p: NVIDIA invented the GPU to bring richer graphics to gamers and creators. That same technology became the engine of modern AI. Today, NVIDIA's accelerated computing platform, spanning chips, systems, and software, powers the AI revolution, from the world's largest data centers and research labs to robotics, autonomous vehicles, and a new generation of AI-native companies.

name: SpaceX | Sequoia Capital
p: SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches the world’s most advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company is revolutionizing space transportation and developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe.
description: We help the daring build legendary companies from idea to IPO and beyond.

name: Airbnb | Sequoia Capital
p: Airbnb brought consumers into the sharing economy with its revolutionary peer-to-peer travel marketplace. Today the company connects people around the world with its unique homes and unforgettable experiences.

Brian, Joe and Nate had a clear vision to disrupt a fragmented vacation rental market. The frustration of trying to book hotels during convention peaks was just the hook. They drew us in further with their scrappiness, imagination and storytelling. If everything went right, Airbnb saw an opportunity to redefine the large, global and enduring travel market.
Airbnb: Building (and Rebuilding) User Trust to Revolutionize Travel
description: We help the daring build legendary companies from idea to IPO and beyond.

name: Etched | Sequoia Capital
p: Etched builds frontier inference clusters designed to run the world’s most advanced AI models faster and more efficiently. It has pioneered technologies including Low Voltage Inference and Cluster Scale Memory, which unlock best-in-class throughput and latency for inference at scale. By co-designing silicon, memory, networking, software and rack-scale systems, Etched turns these breakthroughs into production infrastructure for frontier AI.
by Sonya Huang and Abhishek Malani
description: Etched is building frontier inference clusters to run the world's AI inference as fast and as cheaply as physics allows.

name: Corma | Sequoia Capital
p: Corma is the first frontier AI lab for defensive cybersecurity, building foundation models toward superintelligence for cyber defense. AI has given attackers unprecedented speed, sophistication and scale, but it hasn’t elevated defensive security in the same way. Corma’s mission is to make sure the defenders win the intelligence race in cybersecurity—and every challenge that comes next.
description: Corma is building foundation models toward superintelligence for defensive cybersecurity.

name: Glow | Sequoia Capital
p: Glow is the Endpoint AI company. As AI changes how people work, creating a new generation of risks that traditional reactive tools can’t keep up with, Glow is rethinking endpoint security from the ground up. The company’s AI-powered operating model is built on prevention, not reaction, that fixes the endpoint foundation so organizations can adopt new software and AI on solid ground.
description: Glow is the Endpoint AI company, rethinking endpoint security for the AI era.

name: Sable AI | Sequoia Capital
p: Sable builds Aidan, the first AI employee. Powered by real-time computer use, vision and voice, Aidan enables businesses to run customer interactions at scale. Companies use Sable’s platform to deploy, monitor and continuously improve their AI employees.
Partnering with Sable: Closing the Diffusion Gap
description: Sable builds Aidan, an AI employee powered by real-time computer use, vision and voice to run personalized customer interactions.

name: AIR | Sequoia Capital
p: AIR is the context firewall for AI agents. It sits between agents and the outside world, analyzing and filtering every input entering an agent's context—skills, plugins, MCP servers and sub-agents, plus websites and internal data—and blocking malicious instructions, untrusted data and compromised tools before they influence decisions or actions.
By Bogomil Balkansky, Dean Meyer and David Cahn
description: AIR is the context firewall for AI agents, continuously analyzing and filtering every input into their context.

name: Unconventional AI | Sequoia Capital
p: Unconventional AI is rethinking the foundations of a computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI.
Founded by experts in AI systems, analog circuits, computing theory and neuroscience, we are bringing biology-scale efficiency to artificial intelligence.
description: Unconventional AI is rethinking the foundations of a computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI.

p: Empirik is building the Autonomous Infrastructure Engineer to safely plan, reason about and operate enterprise infrastructure.
description: Empirik is building the Autonomous Infrastructure Engineer to safely plan, reason about and operate enterprise infrastructure.

name: Ent | Sequoia Capital
p: Ent is the intent-aware workspace security platform for securing human and AI-driven work. Built to protect productivity, the new attack surface, Ent understands not just what users and agents do but why, and intervenes at the moment of risk before incidents occur. Ent is in production with Global 2000 customers across hospitality, financial services, defense and more.
description: Ent is the intent-aware workspace security platform for securing human and AI-driven work.

name: Instinct | Sequoia Capital
p: Instinct is an AI agent that handles the deeply personal nuances of everyday life.

name: Cymphony | Sequoia Capital
h2: Partnering with Cymphony: Security Unlocks Adoption
p: Cymphony is the AI security solution for the new workforce. As AI agents and NHIs join the workforce, obscurity stops being a defense—and identity and data security collapse into a single workforce access control problem. With its Workforce Graph, Cymphony maps every person and AI agent in the organization—what they can access, what data they touch and how they behave—then surfaces the risks that actually matter and makes remediation simple, whether automatically or with the security team in control.
By Bogomil Balkansky and Dean Meyer
description: Cymphony is the AI security solution for the new workforce.

name: Mecka | Sequoia Capital
p: Mecka is the data and deployment layer for physical AI. By designing hardware and sensors that digitize the physical world, operationalizing large scale global partnerships across businesses and users, and training frontier video understanding models, Mecka produces the foundations to train and deploy general purpose robotics.
By Anas Biad and James Flynn
description: Mecka is the data and deployment layer for physical AI.

name: TypeSafe AI  | Sequoia Capital
p: TypeSafe makes System One Models for software developers and enterprise teams, returning typed classifications, probabilities and confidence scores for routing, agent control, evaluation, screening and extraction.
description: TypeSafe makes System One Models with classifications and confidence scores for routing, agent control, evaluation, screening and extraction.

name: Catalyst | Sequoia Capital
h2: Partnering with Catalyst: Turning Ideas into Trades
p: Catalyst is the intent layer for all of finance. Catalyst turns ideas, theses or commands into a live strategy across any asset or instrument—from prediction markets and yield to tokens, stocks, commodities and private markets. Catalyst agents research an idea, create the optimal strategy, execute it and monitor continuously.
description: Catalyst allows people to turn any belief into a trade.

name: Healthleap | Sequoia Capital
p: Healthleap shows hospital clinicians which patients need them first. Its software reads the EHR of every inpatient each night. It screens each patient for conditions that often go undiagnosed. Clinicians see the results in the EHR every morning. Patients at risk get care earlier in their stay. Providers get paid for the care they deliver.
description: Healthleap shows clinicians which hospital patients need care first, so treatment starts sooner.
